Name: fgBattleEffects
Desc:
Restore functionality to display the
foreground effects in battle animations
using the effect filenames defined in the
fg_ground and fg_sky data columns in Data_Stages

Requires the battle foreground effect files
hosted on Gamebanana under the title "Restored
Chapter Map/Battle Foreground Effects".




Requires LayeredFS to be enabled to load
the foreground graphic files in modData/data7
